title: New Calendar-Year Benefit Period of a Manufacturer Copay Card — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
A Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs opens the benefit period of a new calendar year, the period running from January 1 to December 31, with a credit of benefit dollars booked on the program's budget account, that is, the card's benefit dollars.

## Year-start rule

A new benefit period is not credited until the budget account carries the closing entry of the period before it. In other words, as long as the budget account shows no closing entry for the period before the new one, the new period receives no credit.

## Effect of opening the period

Opening books one period-opening entry that credits the new period's benefit dollars on the budget account, moves the enrollment's current period to the first and last day given, and adds the credit to the program's benefit dollars. The new period and its dollars then show on the program.

## The opening tool: `open_program_benefit_period_c8eb05d0`

**Capability.** `open_program_benefit_period_c8eb05d0` opens a new benefit period on a copay assistance program and credits its benefit dollars.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `open_program_benefit_period_c8eb05d0` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `enrollment_id` — reference number of the program enrollment, as the program-enrollment lookup returns it. Identifier.
- `benefit_period_start` — first day of the new benefit period. Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone.
- `benefit_period_end` — last day of the new benefit period. Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone.
- `amount_usd` — the benefit dollars credited to the new period. USD, 2 decimal places; rounded half up to the cent when stored.

**Return.** On success a text dictionary with `status` "opened", `activity_id` (reference number of the opening entry), `benefit_period_start` and `benefit_period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount_usd` (dollars credited, 2 decimals) and `benefit_remaining_usd` (program dollars available after the credit, 2 decimals). A reply beginning "Error:" means nothing was opened; the tool returns one when the enrollment named does not exist.

*Hypothetical call:* a period from 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 on a card with $300.00 standing, credited `amount_usd` 9600.00, returns `benefit_remaining_usd` 9900.00.
